newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Tennis-Likhovtseva fights back to win Classic title.
newsitem.headline: Tennis-Likhovtseva fights back to win Classic title.

text.p: Elena Likhovtseva of Russia on Sunday fought back from the brink of defeat to score a 3-6 7-6 (9-7) 6-3 win over Japan's Ai Sugiyama in the final of the Gold Coast Classic women's tennis tournament.
Sugiyama dominated the early stages of the match against third-seeded Likhovtseva with accurate passing shots and raced to a 4-1 lead in the second set after taking the first in convincing fashion.
Likhovtseva took advantage of two successive double faults by Sugiyama in the sixth game of the second set and went on to break her third-seeded opponent's serve twice to force the tiebreaker.
Sugiyama held a match point in the tiebreaker but Likhovtseva again fought back to push the final into a deciding third set.
The Russian, ranked 18th in the world, then took a 3-1 lead over Sugiyama and was never headed as she went on to take her second WTA Tour title.
"I was just thinking I had nothing to lose because I lost the first set and was losing the second set, so I just had to change something," Likhovtseva later told reporters.
